labels: Carrier Frequency iRF carrier used by the ray tracer. Default 3.5 GHz; changing it alters wavelength/material response with little effect on ray count. GHz
Bandwidth iOccupied channel bandwidth for CIR/tap sampling. Default 15.36 MHz; wider bandwidth gives finer delay resolution. MHz
OFDM Carriers iNumber of OFDM frequency bins used for CIR/tap output. Default 512; larger values increase channel post-processing cost.
Subcarrier Spacing iDerived as bandwidth divided by OFDM carriers. Default 30 kHz; sent to the backend as Hz for CIR/taps. kHz
Tx Pattern iSionna antenna pattern used for transmitters. Options come from the backend Sionna registry. iso
Tx Polarization iTransmit antenna polarization. Options come from the backend Sionna registry. V
Tx Rows iNumber of vertical elements in the transmit PlanarArray. Backend caps the total array size.
Tx Cols iNumber of horizontal elements in the transmit PlanarArray. Backend caps the total array size.
Tx V Spacing iVertical element spacing relative to the carrier wavelength. Default 0.5. lambda
Tx H Spacing iHorizontal element spacing relative to the carrier wavelength. Default 0.5. lambda
Rx Pattern iSionna antenna pattern used for link receivers. Options come from the backend Sionna registry. iso
Rx Polarization iReceiver antenna polarization for link solves. Radio maps only use the Tx array. V
Rx Rows iNumber of vertical elements in the receiver PlanarArray.
Rx Cols iNumber of horizontal elements in the receiver PlanarArray.
Rx V Spacing iVertical receiver element spacing relative to the carrier wavelength. Default 0.5. lambda
Rx H Spacing iHorizontal receiver element spacing relative to the carrier wavelength. Default 0.5. lambda

labels: Velocity m/s
Time Step s
Max Steps steps
Samples / Source iMonte Carlo rays per transmitter. Default 30000; higher values reduce noise but scale runtime directly.
Samples / Tx iBase Monte Carlo samples per transmitter for Radio Map. Effective samples scale with the terrain patch subdivision.
Max Paths / Source iUpper bound on retained paths per transmitter. Default 1000000; lowering it protects memory in dense scenes.
Max Depth iMaximum interaction depth for paths. Default 4; each extra depth can multiply search cost. 2 3 4 5 6
Seed iRandom seed for repeatable sampling. Default 42; change it to test solver variance.
Synthetic Array iUses a synthetic antenna array approximation. Default off; can reduce geometric work for array studies.
LoS iDirect transmitter-to-receiver paths. Default on; low extra cost and important as a reference component.
Specular iMirror-like reflections from surfaces. Default on; cost grows with max depth and samples per source.
Diffuse iScattered reflection energy from rough surfaces. Default off; can add variance and solver time.
Refraction iTransmission through materials. Default on; useful around glass and indoor boundaries.
Diffraction iBending around wedges and edges. Default off; improves NLoS modeling but increases PathSolver work.
Edge Diffraction iExplicit edge interaction search for diffracted paths. Default off; enable only when edge effects matter.
Diffraction Lit Region iIncludes lit-region diffraction contributions. Default off; can add paths near shadow boundaries.
Compute Channel Impulse Response (CIR) iRequests compact channel-tap summaries after path solving. Default off; enables the right-side Power Delay Profile section.
Tap l_min iFirst discrete tap index to report. Default 0; keep the range tight for fast channel post-processing.
Tap l_max iLast discrete tap index to report. Default 100; larger ranges increase response size and work.
Enable Live Preview iRuns low-cost previews while moving devices, then a final solve after movement stops. Default off to protect shared GPU time.
Preview Samples / Source iLow-sample path solve used while dragging Link Tx/Rx.
Paths Delay iMinimum seconds between path previews and idle delay before the final solve. s
Patch Size X iRadio-map width in scene meters. Default 160 m; larger patches increase cell count. m
Patch Size Y iRadio-map depth in scene meters. Default 160 m; larger patches increase solve time. m
Height Offset iSampling height above terrain. Default 1.5 m; useful for receiver-height studies. m
Cell Size iOptional XY grid size in meters. Generates a terrain-following measurement grid; leave blank for Auto Density Level. m
Density Level iAuto resolution fallback from 1 to 3. Ignored when Cell Size is set.
Colormap iDisplay color scale for the radio-map overlay and result colorbar. viridis plasma turbo jet
Color Min iLower display bound for radio-map coloring. Default -140 dB; display-only, no solver cost. dB
Color Max iUpper display bound for radio-map coloring. Default -80 dB; display-only, no solver cost. dB
Scenario Name iDataset folder/name used in the DeepMIMO export. Unsafe path characters are sanitized before packaging.
ROI Center X iROI rectangle center X coordinate in the local scene frame. Updated when you draw or edit the ROI. m
ROI Center Y iROI rectangle center Y coordinate in the local scene frame. Updated when you draw or edit the ROI. m
ROI Width iRectangle span along local X. Larger areas create more receiver candidates and longer exports. m
ROI Length iRectangle span along local Y. Larger areas create more receiver candidates and longer exports. m
Rx Spacing iDistance between generated receiver grid points. Smaller spacing creates denser datasets and higher runtime. m
Rx Height iReceiver height above the sampled terrain surface. The ROI footprint controls XY only. m
Max Receivers iSafety cap for generated receiver candidates. Increase only when the Rx Candidates count is intentional.
Chunk Size iReceivers traced per worker batch. Larger chunks reduce overhead but use more memory.
Samples / Source iMonte Carlo rays per transmitter for each chunk. Higher values reduce noise and scale runtime.
Max Paths / Source iUpper bound on paths retained per solve. Higher values may preserve more multipath but use more memory.
Rx Candidates iRead-only estimate of receiver grid points before building filtering.
Filter building footprints iDrops receiver candidates inside building footprint boxes before terrain projection.
